paragraphs: Chapter 1124
Episode 258. The Predator of All Dimensions (14)
A relatively safe zone in this terrible battlefield.
That was originally inside Lafrarosa's shield. But now that the shield was gone and the heat of the Flame Orb covered the entire battlefield, the battlefield was simply a hell with no way out.
Heaps of people melted away every second. Only superhumans, or those comparable, could barely spread a shield to endure the heat and move.
The seventh spear flew towards Lafrarosa.
Krrrrk-!
The spear barely grazed the lower part of Lafrarosa and disappeared somewhere into the darkness of Heluram that covered the sky behind it.
Lafrarosa was dodging the spears spewed by the Flame Orb with increasing ease.
The spear still possessed the power to sink even Lafrarosa in a single blow if it hit, but it was not as sharp as it was at first.
It meant that Kelliark's senses were dulling by that much. He couldn't focus on Lafrarosa because of the offensive from the Genesis Knights and the immortals.

His neck had already been cut dozens of times, and his heart had burst even more than that. The number of times he had allowed attacks to the point where he looked like a randomly lumped mass of meat rather than a human was at least a dozen.
Despite that, Kelliark was continuously showing a resurrection beyond regeneration, but fundamentally, he was human.
A human whose senses dulled when fatigue accumulated and whose life force was finite.

Though he seemed immortal, he too would inevitably reach death if he was hit to a point beyond recovery. It was just that even the senses of the Genesis Knights and the Sun Gods couldn't tell where that line was.
"Everyone, stick to him more tenaciously! If we just keep Rondo and his group in check, Lafrarosa won't be hit by the spear!"
It was Dante. He was the first among the superhumans to notice that Kelliark was getting tired and was keeping Rondo in check.
Five Genesis Knights, the Holy Kingdom knights, and seven gods. Rondo was pressuring Lafrarosa, having selected only those who had never lost their center in the chaotic battle.
"There's only one Genesis Knight, Murakan, and besides, they can't use their ship's cannons anymore. If we can just tie down Lafrarosa once, it's over!"
Rondo shouted in a hoarse voice. His hair was disheveled and his face was gaunt like a beggar's from the continuous fighting without a moment's rest for days on end.
The Azure Flame Demonic Eye. The blue flames raised by Rondo and the Demon Army's Genesis Knights were holding back the Coalition's superhumans.
Genesis Knights, gods, and superhumans.

A large gap was bound to exist between them. Even if they had chosen a life of being Kelliark's weapons, the Demon Army were ultimately those who had reached the rank of Genesis Knight on their own. Just like Phaelito, who had been brainwashed by Zito.
In effect, Murakan alone was breaking down the wall put up by the enemy Genesis Knights and gods. But the problem was that even when he opened a path, the superhumans' entry was slow.
'In the end, must someone make a sacrifice?'
It seemed that they could only properly approach the enemies if one person at a time prepared for death and supported their other comrades.
But it was not a good move. Even if they succeeded in approaching by sacrificing one superhuman, the enemies would be able to create distance again without much difficulty.

'Even assuming I sacrifice myself, the time I can fight in close combat is probably around three minutes. It wouldn't be bad if I could kill just one enemy Genesis Knight in that time, but it's unlikely...'

Compared to the military might of Chiron, Vahn, and Kelliark, they might seem small, but a Genesis Knight was a Genesis Knight. Killing one of the six, including Rondo, in three minutes was clearly impossible. The other way around might be possible.

Moreover, there was a limit to sacrificing superhumans just to seize such an opportunity. It meant having to give up one person each time for a reckless gamble with an extremely low chance of success.
Nevertheless, they had to do it. The moment Lafrarosa was caught in Rondo's encirclement and faltered, Kelliark's spear would strike.
"...When Lord Murakan opens a path this time, I will somehow hold them down."
"If you're thinking that, I'd rather sacrifice myself first."
"Lord Touven."
"Wouldn't it be better for a younger man like you to fight a little longer than me?"
The moment Dante was about to reply, Veradin suddenly pointed at the sky and shouted.
"The ships' power is coming back!"
At those words, everyone looked up at the sky for a moment.
One by one, lights were filling all the hulls still afloat. The ships that had lost their function due to Kelliark's influence were beginning to move again.
Wooooong...!
The power of the fleets was vibrating the sky. It wasn't just the Vamel Alliance's fleet that had regained power. The Demon Army's white fleet was also seen lighting up.

However, if a fleet battle were to resume, the victory lay with the Coalition. The difference in fleet performance had already been proven before Kelliark arrived; the only thing the Demon Army had over the Coalition was sheer numbers.

But even the advantage in numbers was now meaningless. It was the white fleet that had taken a more severe blow from the magic Kelliark had fired indiscriminately and the shockwaves that had spread from the crucible.

Naturally, the fact that the fleet's power had returned now meant that Kelliark was that much more tired. Thanks to this, the superhumans no longer needed to sacrifice each other to fight the enemies.
"Sword Emperor Ship, charge!"
Dante's Sword Emperor Ship, Veradin's Tikan 9th Fleet, and Kinzelo's fleet.

The fleets that had regained their power were rushing towards the enemies as soon as the order was given. A hundred main cannons instantly covered Rondo's group, and the white fleet's reaction was slower than that.
'Of all times...!'
If they had just pressured Lafrarosa one more time, it seemed they could have landed the Flame Orb's spear, but of all times... Rondo gritted his teeth and glared at the surging golden light waves.
"Block it!"
Rondo's group had to form a shield and regroup their formation. The main cannons of the Coalition fleet pounding on the shield were heavier than expected.
"Hahahaha, is it finally time for this body, Ainas, to shine! Bubare, let's shove Grenil into those bastards' skulls!"
"Hehe, let's go, let's go!"
Of course, it was Bishkel who was actually commanding Kinzelo's fleet. Ainas and Bubare were just shouting heartily.
However, the moment their voices were heard, the superhumans for some reason let out a chuckle. In all the nearly five days of fighting this war, this was the first time that hope had come so close.
[I'll take care of keeping the white fleet in check!]
[Alright, you do it, Indestructible One. I'm going to bite their necks off this time for sure.]

The golden fleet's bombardment couldn't penetrate Rondo's group's shield. But right after the bombardment ended, the moment the ship Grenil directly rammed the shield, they flinched and fixed their gaze forward.
A crack had formed in the shield. Without even a moment to refill it with magic, the superhumans' blades were seen digging into the gap.
"Genesis Knights... are strong. But... I'm strong, too."
The first to break through the shield was Bianca. She swung her greatsword, maintaining her characteristic expressionless face even under the pressure of the Genesis Knights and gods.

If she were alone, she wouldn't have lasted long and her whole body would have been torn apart, but Berakt and Badrey supported her from behind, and Zephyrin transformed into her true form and spewed her breath.

Rondo's group raised their senses to create distance. But even after looking all around, it was a blind spot. The golden fleet had already taken up positions behind them, and from both flanks, Murakan and the superhumans were rushing in.
"2nd and 3rd Fleets, focus only on sealing the Holy Army! We will tear them apart!"
"The Iellos(Golem) have also regained their function! The 9th Fleet will support Lord Bale!"
Neither side could be easily broken through. The surrounded Rondo's group had to swallow a sigh as they looked at the rapidly distancing Lafrarosa.
It was just as the eighth spear was emerging from the Flame Orb. If the golden fleet's power hadn't suddenly returned, Rondo would have been able to tie down Lafrarosa with a high probability.
Now it was the other way around; Rondo's side had to risk their lives. To break through the encirclement and quickly approach Lafrarosa, they had no choice but to sacrifice someone.
The Holy Kingdom knights, a force they could afford to lose, were already being bound by the Coalition's seals, and the gods were caught by the Plutonian and couldn't use their power.
'Lord Kelliark came in person, yet we... could lose?'
Rondo was startled by the feeling of his heart sinking.

Suddenly, he felt that something was terribly wrong. Even before Kelliark came, he had been forced to choose mutual destruction, which he hadn't even considered, but now they were in danger of truly being defeated.
He couldn't accept it.
But there wasn't much he could do. The despair that had tormented the Vamel Alliance throughout the battle was now creeping into Rondo's own inner self.
"Midor! You open a path first. The speed at which Lord Kelliark is sending out new spears has slowed. If we can't do it, Lord Kelliark will be in danger..."
Midor Elner of the 550th dimension turned to look at Rondo with an expressionless face.
"Lord Kelliark will be in danger?"
At those words, Rondo was momentarily at a loss for words.
Kelliark in danger. It was something that no one in the Demon Army who knew Kelliark, especially those who had met him in person even once, had ever dared to imagine.

"For what reason do we pledge our allegiance to Lord Kelliark, Lord Rondo? Our leader killed my brother Muron, whom I held more precious than my own life, as if stepping on a bug, and absorbed the Kelliark Zipfel of the 550th dimension, who was my real father. I, who was granted permission to rule the dimension by our leader, became a Genesis Knight while enduring that pain."
"What are you trying to say!"

"Our leader has indiscriminately massacred his subordinates the whole time he's been here, and that must be a judgment made because we are not that necessary. The Kelliark Zipfel of the 33rd dimension symbolizes, literally, the absolute power that rules all dimensions, doesn't he? A true immortality that no god can even approach."
"Midor!"

"But now, our leader is cornered, not like a god, but like a person who was just stronger than us. The reason I swore allegiance to our leader was ultimately the judgment that I could not go against that absolute being, no matter what I did. But if our leader is ultimately a person who cannot overcome a crisis without someone's help... I will not sacrifice myself."
Soon, Midor snorted at Rondo and continued.

"If he was a being who needed our help, I would not have submitted to our leader from the beginning. Don't you see, Lord Rondo? Our leader is already revealing to the whole world that he is not an absolute being."
